admission.justification: Skipping the transferred MQC or adopting a baseline without its attribution loses the evidence the foundation depends on; the guarantee prevents that costly mistake.

applicability: The transferred memory-quality-control and baseline-adoption procedure after the retirement.
conditions: The kept owner is l-01's knowledge command and tool reference (reference/knowledge/commands.md), and the durable result is the contract-scoped checklist memory_quality_check replaces at the reportPath it returns, with no temporary drift report filed.
A retired task-start drift file is not required to run it.
exclusions: Keeping a dead file reference as a compatibility note.
statement: The transferred MQC and baseline-adoption procedure names the current report/result owner rather than requiring a retired task-start drift file.
